pages.text: Raw Cow Ribs have a 25% chance to drop when a Cow is killed by a player using a supported knife or cleaver. Supported weapons are Farmer's Delight's diamond, flint, golden, iron and netherite knives; More Delight's stone and wooden knives; and Dungeon's Delight's flint, diamond, golden, iron, netherite and stained cleavers.
